name: crispe-system-architect-plugin
description: Use when asked to analyze a repo, generate STRUCTURE.md / ARCHITECTURE.md / OVERVIEW.md / CLAUDE.md / CONTRIBUTING.md, map architecture or explain job inputs, outputs and data flows with Mermaid diagrams. Also use for deep code reading, module design and modification guides, verified reusable skills or selected-component skill extraction from a local repo or GitHub URL. Defaults to Quick documentation; supports Deep verified skills and Mix (Quick first, then Deep reusing Quick outputs). 支持分析仓库、架构文档、作业流程图、深度理解代码库、生成可复用 skill、抽取组件；支持中文、English 和中英双语。 Offers documentation before code changes when architecture/context docs are absent.
